config.kuradialmenu.title: KuRadialMenu Settings
config.kuradialmenu.category.slots.toolt: Configure the action for each slot
config.kuradialmenu.option.slotCount.des: Number of slots (4, 8, or 12). Reducing the count discards assignments beyond the new count when saved.
config.kuradialmenu.option.innerRadius.d: Inner radius of the menu in pixels
config.kuradialmenu.option.outerRadius.d: Outer radius of the menu in pixels
config.kuradialmenu.option.centerDeadzon: Radius of the center area where no slot is selected
config.kuradialmenu.option.highlightColo: Color of the selected slot highlight
config.kuradialmenu.slot.description: Use Search to find an action by name, category, or ID. Changes apply only when saved. Slot 1 points up; the remaining slots follow clockwise.
config.kuradialmenu.picker.title: Choose a keybind action
config.kuradialmenu.picker.search: Search by action, category, or ID
config.kuradialmenu.save_error.title: Settings could not be saved
config.kuradialmenu.save_error.detail: Changes are active for this session but have not been saved to disk. Check the config directory permissions and logs, then choose Retry saving. %s
